title: Coalesced Matrix-Free Finite Elements in Cell-Wise Storage
summary: We present a GPU-oriented formulation of continuous high-order finite elements in which the redundant, cell-wise (element-local) vector is the persistent primary representation of all field data, rather than a transient stage of matrix-free operator evaluation.
